title: De Revelatione Capitis Beati Joannis Baptistae Tractatus [Incertus]
author: Pseudo-Cyprian
source: Translated by Claude from stoa0104p.stoa012.opp-lat1, as held by Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina.
statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

passages.original: I. NARRAT Josephus (1) vinctum fuisse abductum Joannem Baptistam in castellum Macheronta, ibi- que caput ejus truncatum fuisse ; narrat historia ecclesiastica (2) sepultum in Sebaste, civitate regio- nis Palesitinæ, quae quondam Samaria est appellata.
passages.english: I. Josephus relates that John the Baptist was taken in chains to the fortress of Machaerus, and that there his head was cut off; the ecclesiastical history relates that he was buried in Sebaste, a city of the region of Palestine, which was once called Samaria.
passages.notes: The numerals (1) and (2) are the edition's footnote markers and are omitted. "Macheronta" is the Greek accusative form of Machaerus. "Palesitinæ" is read as a misprint for "Palaestinae".
